text:
Ari (CS): Pasted the onboarding feedback batch from last week. 14 discrete asks. Major clusters: embeddings quota controls, ability to see cache hit-rate per-route, clearer SDK examples for cost optimization, and a model-fallback config for noisy routes. Suggest quick triage. Reactions: :star: = roadmap, :mag: = needs more context, :warning: = churn-risk

triage-bot: Imported onboarding_bundle_2026_09_03.csv (14 rows). Auto-tags: embeddings_quota, cache_hitrate, sdk_docs, model_fallback

Noemi (PM): Can we sort by "customer ARR" and "expected dev days"? High ARR + low effort = clear quick wins.

Ari (CS): I added arr_bucket and effort_est columns in the shared sheet: https://redwood.internal/sheets/triage-1865432199 (placeholder). Pasting a few rows for visibility:
```
customer,tier,ask,arr_bucket,effort_est
PioneerAI,A,per-team embedding quota & soft alerts,>250k,3-5d
DataHarbor,A,per-route cache hit-rate metric in console and CSV export,>250k,2-4d
QuickForms,B,SDK snippet for batching embeddings + examples to reduce token costs,50-200k,1-2d
EdgeOps,A,automatic model-fallback policy when latency spikes for a route,>250k,5-8d
```

Luca (Eng): DataHarbor's cache hit-rate is doable; backend already emits hit/miss counters per worker. Need a light aggregator and a console chart. Estimate 3 backend days + 1 frontend day.

Noemi (PM): Reacting :star: to QuickForms SDK snippet (super low effort) and :mag: to EdgeOps fallback since we need failure-mode specs.

Ari (CS): marking PioneerAI and EdgeOps as :warning: churn-risk  both mentioned potential pause in rollout if they can't cap embeddings spend or if latency is unpredictable.

triage-bot: Note: 4 accounts flagged as "high churn" during import: PioneerAI, EdgeOps, DataHarbor, FleetGrid.

Dana (Billing): For PioneerAI quota request, we'll need to decide whether quotas are enforced via billing holds or soft alerts tied to budgets. Soft alerts are quicker to implement but won't stop spend.

Luca (Eng): Technical note for model-fallback: we can implement a per-route policy that switches to a smaller quantized model after N consecutive tail-latency spikes, with a cooldown window. Needs feature-flagged rollout.

Noemi (PM): Good. Can we propose two tracks: 1) quick wins (QuickForms SDK, DataHarbor CSV interim export) 2) roadmap projects (PioneerAI quotas, EdgeOps fallback).

Ari (CS): I'm okay offering DataHarbor an interim CSV export of cached metrics while Eng builds the console chart. That should buy time.

Luca (Eng): Interim CSV doable in 1 day from analytics if we expose the aggregated view. I'll mock the query and share sample output.

Dana (Billing): For interim CSVs that customers consume, ensure fields are limited to route_id, window_start, hit_count, miss_count, total_tokens, cost_estimate. No raw payloads.

Ari (CS): noted. Also asked customers to send sample usage ranges to help calibrate quota thresholds. PioneerAI already shared expected daily embedding volume.

Noemi (PM): Scheduling a 20-min triage tomorrow 11:30am PT. Agenda: 1) confirm interim CSV schema for DataHarbor, 2) decide quota semantics for PioneerAI (soft alerts vs enforced cap), 3) owner assignments for SDK snippet. Invite: @Luca @Dana @Ari

Luca (Eng): I'll prepare a one-slide perf/regression checklist for the model-fallback approach and a quick estimate.

Ari (CS): One process request: can PM/Eng call out any asks that are hard-no (privacy/regulatory) so CS stops promising customers? For example, one customer asked to export sample_user_requests for debugging.

Luca (Eng): hard-no on exporting raw user requests unless it's in a private deployment with customer-controlled log forwarding or we have a signed DPA + Legal sign-off. Will add this to the shared sheet.

triage-bot: Reminder: attach sample invoices or usage snapshots when flagging billing/export asks to speed investigation.

Noemi (PM): After the triage I'll convert QuickForms SDK work into a small task, DataHarbor CSV into an interim deliverable, and PioneerAI into a scoped epic with acceptance criteria. Ari will update customers after decisions.

Ari (CS): thanks all  will nudge the A-tier CSMs and follow up here after the 11:30 slot. :thumbsup:
